description: Retrieve only one FHIR resource type for a patient (e.g. Condition, MedicationRequest, Observation) as a Bundle. Supports the same pagination as particle_get_fhir. Endpoint: GET /api/v2/patients/{particle_patient_id}/fhir/{type}.

_page_token.description: Opaque token from a previous page's `link` to fetch the next page.

_since.description: RFC3339 timestamp; only return resources updated since then.

resource_type.description: FHIR resource type, e.g. Condition, MedicationRequest, Observation, AllergyIntolerance.

name: particle_get_fhir_by_type
title: Get FHIR resources by type
